rationale: Kept robust PI+feedforward skeleton but made steady-state feedforward self-re-estimating and faster: y-filter 18s->12s with outlier gate, u-filter 40s->25s, gain update tau 60s->30s with relaxed settled/rate gates, Ki_near 0.022->0.032, INT_LIM 0.35->0.40, U_MAX 0.75->0.80, Kp 0.9->0.75. This lets Kest move from 1.32 to ~0.72 in ~60-90s and ff move from 0.265 to ~0.48, while nominal Kraw~1.29 leaves ff unchanged.
